location_exception_reason: Badminton court roofing sheds are purpose-built structures with standardised BWF dimensions and structural requirements (9 m clear height, 13.4 m × 6.1 m per court) that are location-agnostic; buyer decisions are driven by structural specs, material, and erection capability, not geographic origin. Location in title is redundant.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Fabricator, Contractor) describe who is selling, not what is being sold; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Supplier' from a title leaves the product meaning unchanged.
